verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs describe reference-driven generation. Modify Video V2 reshapes existing footage, motion can be applied from a source video to new styles, and Luma Agents carry style references into generated assets. Image-to-video and video-to-video are also listed. However, the evidence shows no documented style-reference parameter for the video model itself, and the style-transfer behavior rests only on marketing copy. missing for 10: detailed API docs on how a style-reference image or video is supplied and controls output style, explicit image-as-style-reference for Ray video generation (outside Agents), independent or hands-on corroboration of style-matched results

support.subject: As a creator, I can point at a reference video or image and generate new footage in that style

citations.quote: Apply motion from a source video to new subjects, scenes, or styles.
carrying style references, character references, and visual grounding into every asset.
